title: I can't model one pipe

yell.text: I can't fucking model ONE pipe in Blender!

clips.name: first
clips.says: Water seeps in and the pipe slopes downhill to carry it away.

clips.name: result
clips.says: Congratulations, you have built a French drain.

steps.text: Step one: open Zyvo and pick Cutaway Explainer.
Step two: type what you want explained. Like how a French drain works.
Step three: it writes it, voices it, and builds the whole 3D scene.

time.label: REAL JOB LOG: FRENCH DRAIN, START TO VIDEO

end.text: It's called Zyvo. Link in bio. Comment 3D if you're trying it.
